|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Baragwin (V)]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-62-front-master.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Baragwin (V)]] (original, release sheet of 4 September 2009); [[Baragwin (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Baragwin (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); '''this page''' (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Baragwin (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Lost if a Starting Effect on table. Your non-alien characters are power and forfeit = 0. If present at a battleground site, your Force drains at battleground sites where you have two aliens are +1, and when you deploy an alien, retrieve 1 Force.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=9 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010), page 9, slip 62. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 4). Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 (this page), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=4, page 4. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “62” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Baragwin (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “This character is lost” for “Lost”, “Your non-alien characters at sites” for “Your non-alien characters” and “whenever” for “when” (it adds the credit line “(Origninal Concept by Corey Faherty - Nationals 2006)”, typo as published): “This character is lost if a Starting Effect on table. Your non-alien characters at sites are power and forfeit = 0. If present at a battleground site, your Force drains at battleground sites where you have two aliens are +1, and whenever you deploy an alien, retrieve 1 Force. (Origninal Concept by Corey Faherty - Nationals 2006)”<ref name="cl-1261_62-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Baragwin (V) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-baragwin-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Baragwin (V)]]) again, word for word: “Lost if a Starting Effect on table. Your non-alien characters are power and forfeit = 0. If present at a battleground site, your Force drains at battleground sites where you have two aliens are +1, and when you deploy an alien, retrieve 1 Force.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual6-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual6-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034714/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “62” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 4)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Baragwin (V)]]) again, word for word: “Lost if a Starting Effect on table. Your non-alien characters are power and forfeit = 0. If present at a battleground site, your Force drains at battleground sites where you have two aliens are +1, and when you deploy an alien, retrieve 1 Force.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-62-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “62”).
